name: counterprompt
//: For npm run check, Plugin Check must be installed once: npx wp-env run cli wp plugin install plugin-check --activate. One-time after npm run start: npm run setup (installs PHPUnit + polyfills into gitignored vendor/ inside tests-cli).

scripts.check: npm run lint && wp-env run cli wp plugin check counterprompt --exclude-directories=tests,vendor,node_modules,docs,.superpowers --exclude-files=CLAUDE.md,composer.json,composer.lock,package.json,package-lock.json,phpcs.xml.dist,phpunit.xml.dist,.gitignore,.wp-env.json,.phpunit.result.cache
